title: Debounce Filter
statement: Implement a debounce filter that only changes output after the input has remained stable for two consecutive clock cycles. This suppresses mechanical switch bounce. A synchronous reset must initialize the clean output to zero.
module_signature: module debounce_filter(input clk, input rst, input noisy, output reg clean);
behavior: clean changes only when noisy remains stable for two cycles.
clean holds its previous value during instability.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not infer latches or asynchronous glitch detectors.
hint: Store the previous input sample and require agreement across two cycles.
